CLR 44/2021
Hon’ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate,
for the revisionist. 
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, Advocate, for 
the caveator. 
Present revision has been filed 
against the judgment and decree dated 
24.3.2021 passed by JSCC/1st ADJ, 
Haridwar in SCC Case No. 18 of 2016. By 
the impugned judgment, the suit for 
recovery of the arrears of rent, damages 
and eviction has been decreed. 
Revisionist is ready to deposit the 
entire decretal amount. 
Admit.
Summon the LCR.
List for hearing on its turn. 
Meanwhile, it is directed that if the 
revisionist deposits the entire decretal 
amount, adjusting the amount already 
deposited, with the Registry of this Court  within a period of three weeks, he shall 
not be evicted from the premises. In case 
the revisionist fails to deposit the entire 
decretal amount, respondent shall be at 
liberty to execute the decree.
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.)
 24.5.2021
